instructions.name: cancel_capsule
docs: Cancel an active capsule (owner-only): refund all locked assets and close the accounts.

instructions.name: configure_distributor
docs: Set or update the protocol relayer/distributor for private distribution (admin only).

accounts.name: fee_config
docs: Fee config singleton; its authority is the admin gate.

instructions.name: crank_undelegate
docs: Commit ER state and undelegate capsule + vault back to the base layer (crank-callable).

accounts.name: payer
docs: Anyone can call this (crank wallet)

instructions.name: create_capsule
docs: Initialize a new Intent Capsule (SOL/SPL locked in vault; anyone can execute when conditions are met).

accounts.name: platform_fee_recipient
docs: Platform fee recipient (must match fee_config.fee_recipient when creation_fee_lamports > 0)

instructions.name: delegate_capsule
docs: Delegate capsule + vault PDAs to the MagicBlock ER/PER.

instructions.name: distribute_assets
docs: Distribute assets from the vault to beneficiaries (base layer, after execute_intent).

accounts.name: platform_fee_recipient
docs: Platform fee recipient

instructions.name: execute_intent
docs: Execute the intent when the inactivity period is met (permissionless).

accounts.name: permission_program
docs: MagicBlock Permission Program

instructions.name: init_fee_config
docs: Initialize platform fee config (call once after deploy; only authority can update later).

accounts.name: program
docs: This program, used to resolve its ProgramData account.

accounts.name: program_data
docs: The program's ProgramData (BPF upgradeable loader). Constrains init to the program's
upgrade authority (the deployer), so the global fee singleton cannot be front-run on a
fresh deploy by an attacker setting themselves as fee authority (audit C3).

instructions.name: prepare_private_distribution
docs: Prepare private distribution: move remaining vault funds to the distributor (crank-driven).

accounts.name: distributor_config
docs: Pins the relayer the vault funds may move to. Admin-settable via `configure_distributor`,
decoupled from the fee admin so the hot relayer key can differ and rotate (Option B).

accounts.name: platform_fee_recipient
docs: Platform fee recipient (SPL ATA for SPL, wallet for SOL)

accounts.name: distributor_token_account
docs: The distributor's token account (SPL) receiving the remaining funds

accounts.name: distributor
docs: The protocol distributor relayer (Option B). Funds move here only transiently before the
off-chain MagicBlock Private Payments leg fans them out privately to each beneficiary.
Pinned to the admin-configured `distributor_config.distributor` so it CANNOT be an
arbitrary caller draining the vault (audit C1), while still allowing the relayer to be a
dedicated, rotatable wallet distinct from the fee admin.

accounts.name: distribution
docs: Distribution state PDA — created on first private distribution.

instructions.name: recreate_capsule
docs: Recreate (reuse) an executed capsule with a new intent and freshly locked assets (owner-only).

accounts.name: vault_token_account
docs: The vault's ATA. Must already exist (created at the original create_capsule). For SPL
recreate, reuse the same mint so this ATA is present.

instructions.name: restart_timer
docs: Reset the inactivity timer (fail-safe / auto-restart).

accounts.name: authority
docs: Must be the capsule owner. Enforced in the handler against `capsule.owner`.

instructions.name: sample_price
docs: Read a Pyth Lazer / ephemeral oracle price feed (gated behind the `oracle` feature).

instructions.name: schedule_execute_intent
docs: Register a MagicBlock ScheduleTask crank that re-runs execute_intent at intervals.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Payer who signs the schedule transaction (on PER/TEE RPC)

accounts.name: permission_program
docs: MagicBlock Permission Program

instructions.name: send_ccip_from_vault
docs: Send a queued EVM beneficiary transfer through the CCIP Router from vault custody.

accounts.name: ccip_router
docs: Chainlink CCIP Router. Pinned by address: the vault PDA is signed into this program,
so an unconstrained router would let an attacker substitute a malicious program and
drain the SPL vault (audit C2).

instructions.name: update_activity
docs: Update last activity timestamp (called by Helius webhook or user).

instructions.name: update_fee_config
docs: Update platform fee config (authority only).

instructions.name: update_intent
docs: Update the intent data of an existing capsule.

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.msg: Unauthorized: Only the owner can perform this action

errors.name: InactivityPeriodNotMet
errors.msg: Inactivity period has not been met

errors.name: InvalidFeeConfig
errors.msg: Invalid fee config or fee recipient

errors.name: CcipAlreadySent
errors.msg: CCIP transfer already sent for this beneficiary

errors.name: PrivateDistributionNotEnabled
errors.msg: Private distribution is not enabled for this capsule

errors.name: AlreadyDistributed
errors.msg: Assets already distributed for this capsule

errors.name: InvalidDistributor
errors.msg: Distributor is not the authorized protocol distributor

errors.name: InvalidInactivityPeriod
errors.msg: Inactivity period must be greater than zero

types.name: CapsuleVault
docs: Vault PDA holds SOL/SPL locked at capsule creation; anyone can trigger execute when conditions are met.
